headline: No scored news; lines drift as stories fade
body: A quiet weekend day with no scored events. Earlier announcements faded a little, shaving a few hundredths off Protector God, Enslaved God and Descendants. The lower reading left by Friday's GPT-5.6 cheating report and gated preview stays largely in place, with no new events to push it either way. Horizon Balance held at +1.41.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Protector God -0.05 and Enslaved God -0.05.
